notes: Federal Bank's site moved from federalbank.co.in to federal.bank.in. Active co-brands per the bank's co-branded-cards page: Scapia (included here) and OneCard. OneCard (FPL Technologies) uses multiple issuing banks (Federal is one of several, alongside BOB Financial, SBM, CSB, Indian Bank etc.), so the OneCard entry lives in the fintech/psu-minor catalog file rather than here. Discontinued co-brands (closed programs, not just legacy-holder cards): Federal Fi (Amplifi/Simplifi/Magnifi, partner Fi Brand Pvt Ltd) and Federal Edge (Europa Neomarketing). Scapia added BOBCARD as a second issuing partner around May 2026; the Federal-issued Scapia card remains live and its MITC/KFS are still published by Federal Bank (MITC v11 dated 30-04-2026).

cards.name: Celesta
cards.welcome_benefit: Amazon Pay e-voucher worth Rs.600 on spending Rs.10,000+ within first 30 days (bank product page; some aggregators cite higher legacy amounts).
cards.milestone_benefits: Buy-one-get-one on INOX movie tickets once a quarter; premium golf privileges.
cards.lounge_access: 2 international lounge visits per year with no spend criteria; 2 domestic lounge visits per quarter after spending Rs.60,000+ in the previous quarter (up to 8/year).
cards.fuel_surcharge_waiver: 1% fuel surcharge waiver at all fuel stations in India.
cards.eligibility: Top-tier Federal card; income criteria not published (aggregators suggest ~Rs.30,000+/month for premium variants). Min age 21 for unsecured cards.
cards.notes: 3-2-1 reward structure; base rate 1 point per Rs.100. Point value ~Rs.0.25 per aggregator data (catalog/redemption dependent) - not published by the bank. Reward caps not published; assume uncapped until verified. Lifetime-free under a limited-period offer; bank may reintroduce fees for new applicants. Rs.99 convenience fee per redemption request.

cards.name: Imperio
cards.welcome_benefit: Amazon Pay e-voucher worth Rs.400 on spending Rs.5,000+ within first 30 days.
cards.milestone_benefits: Complimentary BigBasket vouchers on quarterly spends of Rs.50,000; BOGO on INOX movie tickets once a quarter.
cards.lounge_access: 2 domestic lounge visits per quarter after spending Rs.40,000+ in the previous quarter (up to 8/year). No international lounge.
cards.fuel_surcharge_waiver: 1% fuel surcharge waiver at all fuel stations in India.
cards.eligibility: Mid-tier family/lifestyle card; income criteria not published. Min age 21 for unsecured cards.
cards.notes: 3-2-1 structure on a base of 1 point per Rs.150 (~0.67 pts/Rs.100): 3x healthcare/grocery, 2x utilities. Point value ~Rs.0.25 (aggregator data, redemption dependent). Reward caps not published. Lifetime-free under limited-period offer (w.e.f. 3 Apr 2023). Rs.99 convenience fee per redemption request.

cards.name: Signet
cards.welcome_benefit: Amazon Pay e-voucher worth Rs.200 on spending Rs.3,000+ within first 30 days.
cards.milestone_benefits: Swiggy vouchers on quarterly spends of Rs.20,000; BOGO on INOX movie tickets once a quarter.
cards.lounge_access: 1 domestic lounge visit per quarter after spending Rs.20,000+ in the previous quarter (up to 4/year).
cards.fuel_surcharge_waiver: 1% fuel surcharge waiver stated for sibling cards; not explicitly confirmed for Signet on the product page.
cards.eligibility: Entry card aimed at young professionals; income criteria not published. Min age 21 for unsecured cards.
cards.notes: 3-2-1 structure on a base of 1 point per Rs.200 (0.5 pts/Rs.100): 3x electronics/apparel, 2x entertainment. Point value ~Rs.0.25 (aggregator data). Reward caps not published. Lifetime-free under limited-period offer. RuPay Signet earns the same 3-2-1 structure and enables UPI spends.

cards.name: Wave
cards.welcome_benefit: 10% cashback on first 5 UPI transactions within 30 days of issuance (max Rs.200 per transaction).
cards.milestone_benefits: 1,000 bonus reward points on quarterly spends of Rs.50,000.
cards.eligibility: Only for existing Federal Bank Visa/Mastercard credit cardholders; applied via FedMobile app. Shares the primary card's credit limit (floater card) with a separate statement.
cards.notes: RuPay UPI companion card: 1 point per Rs.200 (0.5 pts/Rs.100) including UPI spends. Point value ~Rs.0.25 (aggregator data). Not a standalone card - it floats on the primary card's limit and auto-debits via the primary card's payment mode.

cards.name: Scapia Federal
cards.variant: Dual-network co-brand; RuPay variant is UPI-enabled with lower earn rate
cards.lounge_access: Domestic lounge access unlocked by spending Rs.20,000+ in the previous billing cycle (threshold doubled from ~Rs.10,000 in the Feb 2026 revamp; rent/utility/insurance/fuel spends excluded from the threshold). International airport privileges added for Rs.50,000+ bookings via the Scapia app.
cards.fuel_surcharge_waiver: 1% waiver on fuel transactions of Rs.400-4,000, capped at Rs.500/month.
cards.reward_exclusions: No coins on utilities, insurance (MCC 6300), fuel, rent, or wallet loads (rewards on insurance/utility bill payments removed effective 27 Feb 2026). 1% fee + GST on rent payments and wallet loads.
cards.eligibility: Fully digital onboarding via Scapia app; existing Federal Bank credit cardholders are typically ineligible (must close existing Federal card first).
cards.notes: Coins are travel-scrip, not cash: 5 Scapia Coins = Re.1, redeemable only against flights/hotels/trains/buses/products in the Scapia app (rupee_per_point 0.2 assumes travel redemption; effective value-back = 2% general Visa spends, 4% app travel bookings). Post Feb-2026 terms: 10% coins on Visa spends, 5% coins on RuPay/UPI spends (i.e. 5 coins per Rs.100 = 1% on the RuPay variant), 20% coins on Scapia app bookings. Coins valid 36 months, may lapse after 365 days of account inactivity. Zero forex markup retained. Scapia onboarded BOBCARD as a second issuer around May 2026 (Series C announcement); the Federal-issued card continues - Federal Bank still publishes its KFS (v9, 27-01-2026) and MITC (v11, 30-04-2026).

cards.name: Fed StarBiz
cards.welcome_benefit: Amazon Pay e-voucher worth Rs.500 on spending Rs.3,000+ within first 30 days.
cards.eligibility: Business card linked to an existing Federal Bank Overdraft/Cash Credit account (limits up to Rs.50 lakh); transactions up to Rs.3 lakh/day or available OD/CC limit, reflected directly in the OD/CC account (no separate card statement).
cards.notes: 3-2-1 reward structure (3x electronics & apparel, 2x entertainment, 1x other) but the base earn rate per Rs.100 is not published - left null rather than guessed. Annual fee Rs.275 + GST; reissuance Rs.225 + GST. Launched with Visa and NPCI (RuPay) variants.
